blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has suspended its contentious order requiring taxpayers to display their registration seal badges on digital platforms amid growing scrutiny over data privacy concerns. Under Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 113-2026, the BIR said it suspended the requirement until further notice while working with the National Privacy Commission to address the concerns. READ: Deadline to display BIR registration seal badge extended to Oct. 31 In addition, taxpayers who have already complied can continue to display the badge voluntarily, while the authorities will not penalize those who have not complied.
